title: Flood of Ogyges
summary: The flood of Ogyges in Greek tradition, which CFAH-19 reads as an Ice Age meltwater event.
description: The flood of Ogyges in Greek tradition, which CFAH-19 reads as an Ice Age meltwater event. Recorded from a CFAH OSF preprint anchor point (not yet published in ARJ). Added by the CFAH pass.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 1: CFAH anchor point: 1699 BC (AP-107, OSF preprint CFAH-19)

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-19: The Historical Ice Age," OSF preprint v1.0 (8 Jul 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/A5G6X, file CFAH-19_Historical_Ice_Age_v1.0.pdf, p. 9 ("the Flood of Ogyges forms Anchor Point #107, in 1699 BC")

chronologies.date: “from the Flood of Ogyges and the reign of Phoroneus to the first Olympiad was 1020 years”
chronologies.citation: Cory, Ancient Fragments (London: Reeves & Turner, 1876, ed. E. Richmond Hodges), p. 99; Julius Africanus, in the editor's biographical notice (the notice says it is abridged from Bunsen)
chronologies.note: Editor's summary in the biographical notice, which says it is abridged from Bunsen. Not a verbatim fragment. The year of the world is left in the quotation. It is not stored and it is not converted.

chronologies.date: Ogyges Floud happened 100. yeeres after IACOB was borne; and therefore after the generall Floud 613. yeeres.
chronologies.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Book I, Part I, ch. VII, §III, sig. 96a
chronologies.note: Body intake. His reckoning, in the paragraph that begins with what he follows. Not a yeere of the World. year_am stays null. This does not change the sort. The same chapter says this flood fell in the yeere of the World 3440 according to Eusebius, and that Eusebius was much mistaken. That 3440 is not entered.

chronologies.date: the difference betweene these two Flouds must bee 520. yeeres, to which we( allowing 60. more) find 580.
chronologies.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Book I, Part I, ch. VII, §II, sig. 94b
chronologies.note: Body intake. The 520 is what follows if Bucholzerus places Ogyges in his true age. The 580 is his own allowance of 60 more. Later in §. III he reckons 613 yeeres after the general Flood. Both are left as printed. Not a yeere of the World. year_am stays null. This does not change the sort.
